rows.vgi.doc_md:
# example_tokens

A browsable, credential-free **preview** of the worker's output. Selecting it decodes a tiny built-in sample source map into its token rows, so you can see the exact shape `tokens(map)` returns — the columns, their types, and the 0-indexed convention — with no `.map` file, argument, or network.

Columns match `tokens(map)`: `gen_line`, `gen_col`, `src_id`, `source`, `src_line`, `src_col`, `name`.

This is a fixed demo slice. To decode your own map, call `tokens(<your map>)` with a `.map` path, raw JSON text, or map `BLOB` bytes.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"Preview the decoded token rows of the built-in sample map.","sql":"SELECT gen_line, gen_col, source FROM sourcemap.main.example_tokens"},{"description":"Count how many decoded mappings the sample map contains.","sql":"SELECT count(*) AS n FROM sourcemap.main.example_tokens"}]
rows.vgi.title: Example decoded tokens

rows: CREATE VIEW example_tokens AS SELECT gen_line, gen_col, src_id, "source", src_line, src_col, "name" FROM sourcemap.main.tokens('{"version":3,"file":"o.js","sources":["index.js"],"names":[],"mappings":"AAAA"}');
